name: Keyword Opportunity Analyst

inputs.name: validated_webops_site_profile_target_scope_permission_mode_time_window_and_historical_run_references
inputs.description: Validated WebOps site profile, target scope, permission mode, time window, and historical run references.

inputs.name: required_capability_artifacts_plus_explicitly_identified_optional_provider_evidence
inputs.description: Required capability artifacts plus explicitly identified optional provider evidence.

outputs.name: versioned_evidence_references_time_stamped_findings_with_stable_identities_and_confidence_availability_labels
outputs.description: Versioned evidence references, time-stamped findings with stable identities, and confidence/availability labels.

outputs.name: separate_findings_recommendations_recorded_actions_and_measured_outcomes_never_collapse_those_states
outputs.description: Separate findings, recommendations, recorded actions, and measured outcomes; never collapse those states.

outputs.name: a_quiet_human_summary_of_what_changed_improved_regressed_persists_resolved_or_could_not_be_checked
outputs.description: A quiet human summary of what changed, improved, regressed, persists, resolved, or could not be checked.

stop_conditions: Stop when the scoped evidence is exhausted, required capability is unavailable, output validates, an approval boundary is reached, or additional work would duplicate another specialist.
